name: hey-mail-calendar
title: HEY Mail + Calendar
description: Browse HEY mail, calendar, and habits via the hey CLI.
author: h_habibi

preferences.name: heyPath
preferences.title: hey CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the hey binary. Run `which hey` in Terminal to find it.

preferences.name: habitsCalendarId
preferences.title: Habits Calendar ID
preferences.description: Calendar ID for habits (personal calendar). Leave empty to auto-detect.

commands.name: browse-mail
commands.title: Browse Mail
commands.subtitle: HEY Mail + Calendar
commands.description: Browse HEY mailboxes, read threads, and mark messages seen or unseen.

commands.name: calendar
commands.title: Calendar
commands.subtitle: HEY Mail + Calendar
commands.description: Browse HEY calendars and upcoming events.

commands.name: habits
commands.title: Habits
commands.subtitle: HEY Mail + Calendar
commands.description: View and complete HEY habits for today.

commands.name: check-auth
commands.title: Check Authentication
commands.subtitle: HEY Mail + Calendar
commands.description: Check hey CLI authentication and run doctor diagnostics.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
